_comment: Copied to <your-projects-root>/<project>/cold-outreach-builder/config.json on the first run. Replace placeholders; never commit a real config to the agent folder. goal: book call | try free | give feedback | partnership | relationship. sender.first_name is rendered into {{sender_first_name}} at export only, from this private file; leave it empty to let the sequencer fill the token. sender.domain and sender.dkim_selector feed scripts/check_sender.py (DNS only, never an SMTP probe). research.agent_cmd is an optional model CLI that reads a brief on stdin (run_dossiers.py run); empty means sub-agents or sequential work in the session. Project copies of criteria.json, limits.json and reply-rules.json, next to this file, override the shipped assets key by key. Optional: a "tools" object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json) overrides the project's tool choices for this agent only.
